mainTopic: Whether the meat of the פרה אדומה can become impure as food (טומאת אוכלין)
overview: This amud brings one short ruling about the meat of the פרה אדומה. Normally only something that counts as food can pick up טומאת אוכלין, the kind of impurity that food gets. It is forbidden to eat or benefit from the meat of the פרה אדומה, so you might think it is not food at all. The ruling says it can still become impure as food. The reason is הואיל והיתה לה שעת הכושר: there was once a time when it was fit to be eaten. That earlier moment of fitness lets it keep its food status even after it became forbidden.

steps.title: The פרה אדומה can become impure like food
steps.stepSummary: The meat of the פרה אדומה can become impure with טומאת אוכלין, because it once had a time when it was fit to be eaten.
steps.simpleTranslation: The פרה אדומה can become impure the way food does, since there was a time when it was fit.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ruling that the meat of the פרה אדומה can pick up the טומאה of food, and it gives a reason.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Normally, only something that counts as food can get טומאת אוכלין, and the פרה אדומה is forbidden to eat. The ruling says it still counts as food because of הואיל והיתה לה שעת הכושר: there was once a time it was fit. That earlier fitness keeps its food status even after it became forbidden.

keyTerms.meaning: The red heifer, whose ashes are used to purify people from טומאת מת
It can become impure with the kind of טומאה that food gets
A time when it was fit or usable (here, fit to be food)

steps.whatToRemember: Something that once had a שעת הכושר as food can keep the status of food for טומאה, even after it becomes forbidden.
steps.confusionAlert: 'מטמא' here means the meat can BECOME impure as food. It is not saying the פרה makes other things impure.
steps.whyThisMatters: The idea of הואיל והיתה לה שעת הכושר shows that a thing's status can depend on an earlier moment of fitness, not only on what it is right now.

phrases.english: The red heifer can become impure with the impurity of food,
since there was a time when it was fit.
phrases.notes: Fit to be eaten as food, at least at some point.
